_comment: Replace placeholders: Api:BaseUrl = your backend; GoogleAuth:ClientId = OAuth client ID from Google Cloud (Desktop/Web with http://127.0.0.1:PORT/). OpenVpn.IgnoreRedirectGateway=true avoids full-tunnel (fixes broken general Internet) but your public IP usually won’t change; use false for full VPN. OpenVpn.UdpBridgeFramed=false if UDP VPN fails with TLS errors (raw WS frame = one UDP datagram). No client secret in this file.
